security_audit.summary: Most static findings are markdown backtick false positives or benign “Anti-Patterns” headings. The real risks are unrestricted report output writes in the helper scripts and command examples that can install packages or modify Docker and Kubernetes environments.

remediation.issue: Helper scripts write JSON reports to any --output path without confirmation.
remediation.suggestion: Resolve output paths, reject traversal outside the project, and require confirmation before overwriting existing files.

remediation.issue: Documentation lists package installation, Docker, and Kubernetes commands without safety gates.
remediation.suggestion: Add explicit user confirmation guidance before dependency installs, Docker changes, or kubectl apply operations.

content.user_title: Build Fullstack Apps With Senior Guidance
content.value_statement: Fullstack projects often need consistent setup, architecture choices, and quality checks. This skill provides scripts and references for React, Next.js, Node.js, GraphQL, and PostgreSQL work.
actual_capabilities: Provides three Python helper scripts for scaffolding and code quality review workflows.
Validates a target path before running local analysis or report generation.
Can print a basic report with target, status, and finding count.
Can export script results as formatted JSON to a selected output file.
Documents stack guidance for React, Next.js, Node.js, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Docker, and cloud tools.
Includes reference notes for architecture patterns, development workflows, and common troubleshooting.
limitations: The helper scripts contain placeholder analysis logic and do not create a complete application.
Reference documents are generic and need project-specific validation before use.
Command examples can change dependencies, Docker state, or Kubernetes resources.
The skill does not provide live dependency research or production monitoring.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Web App
use_cases.description: Create a practical starting plan for a React, Next.js, Node.js, and PostgreSQL project.

use_cases.title: Review Repository Quality
use_cases.description: Run local checks and summarize architecture, setup, and maintainability gaps in an existing codebase.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Workflows
use_cases.description: Use the references to align setup, testing, deployment, and troubleshooting practices across a team.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Project Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the senior-fullstack skill to outline a setup plan for my new web application. Include stack choices, first commands, and quality checks.

prompt_templates.title: Review My Repository
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the senior-fullstack skill to inspect this repository. Summarize setup issues, architecture risks, and the safest checks to run first.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Development Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the senior-fullstack references to propose a development workflow for builds, tests, linting, environment setup, and troubleshooting.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Architecture Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the senior-fullstack skill to prepare an architecture review. Cover frontend, backend, data, DevOps, security, performance, and migration risks.

output_examples.input: Review a new Next.js and Node.js repository for setup readiness.
output: Setup status with missing configuration and dependency steps.
Architecture notes for frontend, backend, database, and deployment concerns.
Recommended quality checks before implementation continues.

output_examples.input: Create a workflow for a team adopting GraphQL and PostgreSQL.
output: Suggested development workflow from local setup through review.
Testing, linting, and troubleshooting checkpoints for the team.
Risks that need confirmation before package or deployment commands run.

output_examples.input: Summarize what the code quality analyzer produced for a target path.
output_examples.output: A concise report showing the target path, success status, finding count, and next review actions.

best_practices: Confirm before running package installation, Docker, or Kubernetes commands from the skill documentation.
Review generated reports manually because the current scripts use placeholder analysis logic.
Run helper scripts from a trusted project directory with explicit target and output paths.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the helper scripts as a complete production scaffolding system.
Do not run deployment commands without checking the active Docker or Kubernetes context.
Do not write report output over source files or configuration files.

faq.question: Does this skill build a full application automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance, reference material, and simple helper scripts for planning and review workflows.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What stacks does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, GraphQL, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Docker, Kubernetes, and major clouds.

faq.question: Are the included scripts safe to run?
faq.answer: They are simple local scripts, but output paths and command effects should be reviewed before execution.

faq.question: Does the analyzer perform deep code analysis?
faq.answer: No. The current analyzer validates the target path and emits a basic placeholder report.

faq.question: When should I use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it for project setup planning, architecture review, workflow alignment, and basic local quality reporting.
